newsitem.title: CHINA: DuPont China polyester film plant starts up.
newsitem.headline: DuPont China polyester film plant starts up.

text.p: A $70 million polyester film joint venture in southern China between DuPont Co of the U.S. and a Chinese firm has begun operation, the China News Service said on Monday.
The DuPont Hongji Film Co Ltd in Foshan in Guandong province had a production capacity of 10,000 tonnes of polyester film a year, the agency said.
DuPont and Chinese partner No. 3 Foshan Plastics Factory Co Ltd had invested a combined $70 million in the project, it said. It did not say how much each side had contributed.
The venture would export to the United States, Brazil, Argentina and Japan, it said without giving further details.
